name: Fairytale
body:
[Source: GB19]

A challenging drug to refine, fairytale triggers soothing hallucinations, which the user can project into the minds of others or conjure into reality as flitting lights.

DETAIL

Type injury (injected); Addiction moderate, Fortitude DC 18; Price 800 gp

EFFECT

2 hours; +2 alchemical bonus to Will saves against magic effects and a –2 penalty to Perception checks. During this time, gain dancing lights, deep slumber, and wisp ally as spell-like abilities (CL 9th), each usable once.

DAMAGE

1d4 Charisma damage
